title: Snapshots protect running work
when: When editing a plan that already has attached/materialized requirements or an execution in progress.
need: Attachment/materialization turns definitions into subject-bound requirements. Frozen release snapshots retain source revisions and definitions; a later shared-plan sync cannot change what that candidate tests. Source revisions not carried by the candidate refuse with recovery before materialization or refresh. Existing evidence stays immutable.
gap: Snapshot and convergence prose is split across public/private pages. Review question: should one canonical plans reference own it and plan-edit output link that owner?
surface_notes: Saved QA plan → materialized requirements: Reusable definitions and their subject-bound requirements are distinct records. Later edits follow explicit snapshot/currency rules rather than rewriting old proof.
